claims.citation: New York Herald, 11 September 1866, p. 9, col. 1
The Sun (New York), 13 September 1866, p. 4, col. 4

claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Manchester (Br.), Jones, Liverpool Aug. 25 and
Queenstown 27th, with mdse. and 435 pass. to John G. Dale. 10th
inst., 9 a. m., lat. 40 57, long. 64 53, saw a large steamer on each beam
bound E; 2d inst., 9:15 a. m., lat. 47 28, long. 36 37, exchanged num-
bers with ship Freeman, bound W, (probably the Freedom from
Shields for New-York); Aug. 28, 5:30 p. m., lat. 51 15, long. 13 33, saw
a large steamship bound E.
